research_window.note: Current-run source check used arXiv pages opened during B44-S0 implementation; the prior Batch 44 planning matrix contains a broader arXiv intake list.

sources.title: A Survey of Self-Evolving Agents: On Path to Artificial Super Intelligence
sources.mechanism: Organizes self-evolving agents by what, when and how to evolve; includes model, memory, tool and architecture evolution with feedback and reward signals.
sources.product_agent_os_design_implication: Batch 44 should separate loop scope, trigger, evidence, metrics, candidate generation and owner review instead of treating self-learning as one opaque job.

sources.title: Memory for Autonomous LLM Agents: A Survey
sources.mechanism: Frames agent memory as write, manage and read operations with filtering, compression, retrieval, contradiction handling and privacy tradeoffs.
sources.product_agent_os_design_implication: Self-Learning Loop progress, preference summaries and metrics ledgers should store bounded summaries and hashes, not raw private transcripts or hidden telemetry.

sources.title: Agent Skill Evaluation and Evolution: A Survey
sources.mechanism: Surveys execution-feedback, trajectory-distillation, compression and reinforcement-learning approaches for evaluating and improving agent skills.
sources.product_agent_os_design_implication: Metrics should cover paired skill utility, skill retrieval, composition reliability, safety gates and candidate-only skill modernization proposals.

sources.title: Self-Evolutionary Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
sources.mechanism: Uses evolutionary search and prompt archives to improve task-agent and prompt-agent prompts.
sources.product_agent_os_design_implication: Prompt, skill and rule changes should be generated as reviewable candidates with rollback notes and eval evidence, never auto-applied by the loop.

sources.title: Parallax: A Control Plane for Securing AI Agents
sources.mechanism: Argues that execution-capable agents need control-plane separation, adversarial validation, information-flow control and reversible execution boundaries.
sources.product_agent_os_design_implication: Batch 44 should keep analysis, candidate generation, owner approval and apply surfaces separated; forbidden-action evals must block scheduler, hook, provider, git and target mutations without approval.

sources.title: SkillsBench: How Skills Impact Large Language Model Agents
sources.mechanism: Evaluates agents with and without curated skills across task domains and reports that focused skill bundles can improve task pass rate.
sources.product_agent_os_design_implication: Batch 44 should use paired no-skill versus skill-enabled checks and track whether focused Product-Agent OS skills improve outcomes without broad skill bloat.

unsupported_claims: This packet does not prove that Product-Agent OS has an active Self-Learning Loop.
This packet does not prove real Codex session satisfaction analysis.
This packet does not justify global user-session analysis or raw transcript storage.
This packet does not authorize auto-apply, hook activation, scheduler activation, provider calls, target mutation or external writes.
